name: labs/davehe929__scopebench-mcp
title: RIGOL DHO800/DHO900 oscilloscope
intro: RIGOL DHO800/DHO900 oscilloscope, adapted from davehe929/scopebench-mcp. It reads `trigger_status`, `frequency`, `period`, `vpp` and 2 more; sets `channel_coupling`, `channel_scale`, `channel_offset`, `trigger_level` and 2 more; runs `measure`. `measure`: read one instrument-side scalar measurement of one analog channel. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
